regions.merged_text: Our Friend Fr. Gabriel drove down from Notre Dame Today and had quite a nice little visit with us. He was telling of you not being too well recently. I surely sympathise with you and hope your re- covery may come speedily, God willing - God Willing. .... It would a great thing for you if you and your Brothers could, a little trip to the scenes of Quebec, Mont Royal, etc. .. I surely would enjoy going. Please let us hear from you. . Keep well . .

regions.merged_text: Dear Brothers Like flowers of Autumn we bloom and shortly fade. and sisters your lesson to me is your very life. Like you I must die but my soul continues and finally will claim my whole risen self. Blessed be God in all His designs!
